caption: Mythen, Schwyz
composition: Schwyz looking east to the Grosser Mythen and Kleiner Mythen · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the edge of Schwyz, the Grosser Mythen and the Kleiner Mythen rise as two steep, isolated rock peaks east of the town. Pastures and roofs sit far below the cliffs. The lower slopes are still green in late September, the summits are rock rather than snow pyramids, and this is the Mythen view rather than the town-hall square. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast, so cloud sits on the peaks while the two summits stay identifiable, with no rain.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Grosser Mythen and Kleiner Mythen above Schwyz
